title: Crossy Road State Sheets
summary: 52 state sprites for ALL 13 agents in 4 states: working, speaking, thinking, done.
content:
Crossy Road State Sheets

ALL 13 agents x 4 states = 52 sprites at 128x128 transparent PNG.

States

Working

  • Body tilted forward (-3deg)
  • Arms in typing position
  • Eyes focused (narrow)
  • Amber dot indicators floating above (...)
  • Aura at 60% intensity
  • File: {agent}-working.png

Speaking

  • Body tilted back slightly (+2deg)
  • One arm in gesture pose
  • Eyes wide open
  • White speech bubble with bouncing dots
  • Aura at 80% intensity
  • File: {agent}-speaking.png

Thinking

  • Body tilted forward (-5deg)
  • One arm raised to chin
  • Eyes squinting
  • Blue floating question mark
  • Aura at 50% intensity
  • File: {agent}-thinking.png

Done

  • Body centered, lifted 6px up
  • Both arms raised in celebration
  • Eyes happy (curved down)
  • Signature-color spinning stars
  • Green checkmark badge
  • Platform squished (wider, shorter)
  • Aura at 100% intensity
  • File: {agent}-done.png

Bobby Integration

Loading states

const STATES = ['working', 'speaking', 'thinking', 'done'];

// Map agent status to state sprite
function getStateSprite(agentId, status) {
  const stateMap = {
    'ACTIVE': 'working',
    'SPEAKING': 'speaking',
    'THINKING': 'thinking',
    'DONE': 'done',
    'IDLE': null, // use crossy-road/{agent}-128.png for idle
  };
  const state = stateMap[status];
  if (!state) return `/assets/characters/crossy-road/${agentId}-128.png`;
  return `/assets/characters/crossy-road/states/${agentId}-${state}.png`;
}

Transition timing

  • State change: 300ms crossfade between sprites
  • Done state: add a 100ms scale(1.1) pop before settling
  • Working state: gentle 2px bob animation (CSS, not sprite swap)
  • Speaking state: sync speech bubble dots with any text animation

Combining with idle

The idle sprites at crossy-road/{agent}-128.png (Gemini-generated) remain the default. These state sheets activate when the agent status changes. ALL 13 agents now have full state sheets. No fallback needed.

Render Script

scripts/render-state-sheets.js

To regenerate or add agents, edit the AGENTS object in the script and run:

node projects/steffen/scripts/render-state-sheets.js
